name: winpub-windowsnat1
prompt:
Forgejo CI workflow (YAML, shell) of a C++ game engine: the Windows test job's text reports are pushed to a windows-results branch so they can be read without downloading the artifact.  Make these 2 edits in .forgejo/workflows/windows-native.yml, each its own SEARCH/REPLACE block.
Edit 1. Your SEARCH block is exactly these lines:
```
# unit tests and every demo on it natively, in minutes instead of the VM's hours.
# The VM job (vm-tests.yml) stays as the fallback for when the PC is off.
# Runs nightly and by hand; the 'quick' input reduces demo duration to 8 s each.
name: Windows (native)
```
and your REPLACE block is exactly these lines, copied as they are:
```
# unit tests and every demo on it natively, in minutes instead of the VM's hours.
# The VM job (vm-tests.yml) stays as the fallback for when the PC is off.
# The text reports (summary, test results, benchmark JSON; no screenshots)
# are also pushed to the windows-results branch, so they can be read
# without signing in to download the artifact.
# Runs nightly and by hand; the 'quick' input reduces demo duration to 8 s each.
name: Windows (native)
```
Edit 2. Your SEARCH block is exactly these lines:
```
          name: windows-native
          path: results/
```
and your REPLACE block is exactly these lines, copied as they are:
```
          name: windows-native
          path: results/

  publish:
    needs: test
    if: always() && needs.test.result != 'skipped'
    runs-on: soucouyant
    timeout-minutes: 15
    container:
      image: git.kreative-kompas.com/khyretos/kke-ci:1
    steps:
      - uses: https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: windows-native
          path: results

      - name: Push the text reports to the windows-results branch
        run: |
          set -e
          url="${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}"
          auth="Authorization: token ${{ github.token }}"
          git init -q history
          if git -C history -c http.extraHeader="$auth" fetch -q --depth=1 "$url" windows-results 2>/dev/null; then
            git -C history checkout -q -b windows-results FETCH_HEAD
          else
            git -C history checkout -q --orphan windows-results
          fi
          run="runs/$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H%MZ)-${GITHUB_SHA::10}"
          mkdir -p "history/$run"
          (cd results && find . -type f \( -name '*.md' -o -name '*.json' -o -name '*.txt' -o -name '*.log' \) ! -name 'password*') |
            while read -r f; do mkdir -p "history/$run/$(dirname "$f")"; cp "results/$f" "history/$run/$f"; done
          echo "- $run: ${{ github.ref_name }}, test job ${{ needs.test.result }}" >> history/index.md
          cd history
          git config user.name "forgejo-actions"
          git config user.email "forgejo-actions@kreative-kompas.com"
          git add -A
          git commit -q -m "Windows results for ${GITHUB_SHA::10} (${{ github.ref_name }})"
          git -c http.extraHeader="$auth" push -q "$url" HEAD:refs/heads/windows-results
```
Change nothing else; do not copy or move any other line.
